sections.name: boot
sections.desc: search engine cold boot; empty index; the query line wakes up

sections.name: rank
sections.desc: Side by side: a ranking table climbs, scores fill, the bubble inflates and pops

sections.name: memory
sections.desc: memories indexed into slots; the sweetest one is highlighted and pinned last

sections.name: table
sections.desc: query TABLE: constraint filter (height = elbow), wobbly stubby leg, only perfect match

sections.name: eggplant
sections.desc: query EGGPLANT: purple swatch, scratch-mark texture, nutrition fields, perfect match

sections.name: search1
sections.desc: I'm searching: full-screen query spinner sweeping the index

sections.name: cat
sections.desc: fuzzy match CAT: blue point facets, meow/hiss, purr = 0 results

sections.name: steak
sections.desc: recipe index card: fillet mignon, mushroom sauce, doneness gradient

sections.name: flower
sections.desc: bloom cycle plot: the rarest bloom, petal geometry, perfect match

sections.name: human
sections.desc: sensor readouts: hand temperature curve, unruly hair field, perfect match

sections.name: search2
sections.desc: I'm searching: deeper crawl, posting lists, the cursor never stops

sections.name: typeahead
sections.desc: autocomplete fails: candidate words struck out one by one, caret blinking

sections.name: love
sections.desc: the typeahead finally lands on LOVE; hit animation, result locks

sections.name: embed
sections.desc: embedding cloud: everything resembles you; the query morphs through every form

sections.name: rapid
sections.desc: searching for, searching for: rapid repeat queries, results flicker

sections.name: lostself
sections.desc: my old self that's gone: the index entry is deleted, an empty result set

sections.name: buckets
sections.desc: each one of us has a bucket of love: histogram of buckets filling

sections.name: tokens
sections.desc: tokenise to the cell, then BPE-merge back up: the whole is not the pieces

sections.name: callback
sections.desc: flower and human again, now with the accumulated context of the search

sections.name: search3
sections.desc: I'm searching: last sweep, the index is nearly exhausted

sections.name: dogfruit
sections.desc: query DOG (ruff ruff) and query FRUIT (tomato, full of juice)

sections.name: outro
sections.desc: the search returns: one result, 'you'; index closed, CRT off, credits
